vocabulary.meaning_en: jobs you do to keep your home clean and tidy
vocabulary.note_ar: household = متعلق بالبيت، chore = مهمة روتينية
vocabulary.example: We share the household chores at the weekend.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean the floor with a broom
vocabulary.example: Please sweep the kitchen floor.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean the floor with water and a mop; the tool used for this
vocabulary.example: I mopped the floor after dinner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean using an electric machine that sucks up dirt
vocabulary.example: Can you vacuum the carpet?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to remove dust from furniture; very small pieces of dirt
vocabulary.example: She dusted the shelves every Friday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean something with water and soap
vocabulary.example: Wash your hands before eating.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to rub something hard to clean it
vocabulary.example: He scrubbed the pot until it was shiny.

vocabulary.meaning_en: clothes that need to be washed or have just been washed
vocabulary.example: I do the laundry on Saturdays.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something not wet; not wet
vocabulary.example: Hang the clothes outside to dry.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make clothes smooth using heat; a metal, or the tool for ironing
vocabulary.note_ar: حرف r لا يُنطق كما يُكتب: تُنطق /ˈaɪərn/
vocabulary.example: I need to iron my shirt for the interview.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to bend cloth or paper so one part lies on another
vocabulary.example: Fold the towels and put them away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put something on a hook or line so it hangs down
vocabulary.note_ar: لا نشدد على صوت g في نهاية ng
vocabulary.example: Hang your coat by the door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a curved piece of metal or plastic for hanging things
vocabulary.example: The keys are on the hook.

vocabulary.meaning_en: soap powder or liquid for washing clothes or dishes
vocabulary.example: We've run out of detergent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that washes clothes
vocabulary.example: Put the towels in the washing machine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to clean plates, cups and pans after a meal
vocabulary.example: It's your turn to wash the dishes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put plates, forks and glasses on the table before a meal
vocabulary.example: Can you set the table for six people?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to remove plates and things from the table after eating
vocabulary.example: The children cleared the table after lunch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put the rubbish outside the house
vocabulary.example: Don't forget to take out the trash tonight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tidy the sheets and blankets on a bed after sleeping
vocabulary.example: I make my bed every morning.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give water to plants
vocabulary.example: Who will water the plants while we're away?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give food to a person or animal
vocabulary.example: I feed the cat twice a day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an animal you keep at home
vocabulary.example: Do you have any pets?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a place neat and put things where they belong
vocabulary.example: Tidy up your room before your friends come.

vocabulary.meaning_en: tidy and well organised
vocabulary.example: Her handwriting is very neat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a brush with a long handle for sweeping
vocabulary.example: The broom is behind the kitchen door.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cloth or tool for removing dust
vocabulary.example: Use the duster on the bookshelf.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft object that holds water, used for washing
vocabulary.example: Wash the pan with a sponge.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a basket for dirty or clean clothes
vocabulary.example: Put your dirty socks in the laundry basket.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a low sound because you are unhappy or annoyed
vocabulary.example: He groaned when he saw the homework.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to shout happily or to encourage someone
vocabulary.example: The fans cheered when the team scored.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a thin stick a magician uses
vocabulary.example: I wish I had a magic wand to clean the house.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move away a little from something
vocabulary.example: Stand back! The door is opening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: will (more formal or literary); used in offers like 'Shall I...?'
vocabulary.example: Shall I open the window?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short trip to do a job, like going to the bank
vocabulary.example: I have a few errands to run this afternoon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move your hand or a cloth over a surface
vocabulary.example: He rubbed his hands to keep them warm.

fine_lines.title: rub vs scrub
fine_lines.explanation_ar: rub حركة عامة للفرك أو المسح، مثل فرك اليدين ببعض لتدفئتهما. scrub فرك ودعك بقوة لتنظيف شيء صعب، مثل بقعة عنيدة على الأرض أو قدر محروق.

examples.sentence: She rubbed her eyes because she was tired.
Rub your hands together if you feel cold.
I had to scrub the floor to remove the stain.
Scrub the potatoes before you cook them.

fine_lines.title: chores vs errands
fine_lines.explanation_ar: chores هي المهام الروتينية داخل البيت مثل غسل الأطباق وترتيب السرير. errands هي المشاوير التي تقوم بها خارج البيت مثل الذهاب إلى البنك أو شراء أغراض من السوبرماركت.

examples.sentence: Washing the dishes is my least favourite chore.
I need to run some errands: the post office and the bank.

fine_lines.title: clean vs clear (the table)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: clean the table تعني تنظيفها من البقع أو الأوساخ. clear the table تعني رفع الأطباق والملاعق والأشياء من عليها بعد الأكل.

examples.sentence: Clean the table with a wet cloth.
Please clear the table so I can put my laptop on it.

fine_lines.title: sweep vs mop vs vacuum
fine_lines.explanation_ar: ثلاث طرق لتنظيف الأرض: sweep بالمكنسة اليدوية (المقشة)، mop بالماء والممسحة، vacuum بالمكنسة الكهربائية.

examples.sentence: Sweep the leaves off the balcony.
Don't walk there, I just mopped the floor.
I vacuum the carpet once a week.

expressions.phrase: It will all come out in the wash
expressions.meaning_ar: كل شيء سيتحسّن والحقيقة ستظهر في النهاية / ستمرّ
expressions.example: Don't worry about the mistake. It will all come out in the wash.
I'm going to run some errands after work.
Who usually does the laundry in your house?
Stand back! The pan is very hot.

grammar.title: By the time + past simple, past perfect
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم by the time (بحلول الوقت الذي) مع الماضي البسيط، ثم الماضي التام للحدث الذي كان قد حدث قبله. بالعربي: «بحلول الوقت الذي حدث فيه كذا، كان قد حدث كذا». الماضي التام يخبر المستمع أي حدث جاء أولاً.
examples: By the time James arrived, Emma had already started the laundry.
By the time the flat was tidy, Ali had fallen asleep.
By the time Omar finished writing the list, Ali had gone to the kitchen.

grammar.title: Order of events: past simple vs past perfect
grammar.explanation_ar: إذا استخدمنا الماضي البسيط للحدثين مع and فهذا يعني أنهما حدثا بالترتيب الذي ذكرناه. أما الماضي التام فيوضح أن الحدث بدأ أو انتهى قبل الحدث الآخر.
examples: James arrived and Emma started the laundry. (James first)
When James arrived, Emma had started the laundry. (Emma first)

grammar.title: shall
grammar.explanation_ar: shall مثل will تماماً في المعنى لكنها أكثر رسمية أو أدبية. وتُستخدم كثيراً في العروض والاقتراحات مع I و we في السؤال.
examples: I shall sweep the floor and save the kingdom!

questions.question: Going to the bank and the post office are:
There's a hard stain on the floor. You need to ___ it.
questions.explanation_ar: الدعك بقوة لإزالة بقعة صعبة = scrub.

questions.question: After dinner, please ___ the table: take the plates to the kitchen.
questions.explanation_ar: رفع الأطباق بعد الأكل = clear the table.

questions.question: By the time I got home, my brother ___ all the pizza.
questions.explanation_ar: الأكل حدث قبل الوصول = الماضي التام had eaten.

questions.question: What do you use to make clothes smooth?
"It will all come out in the wash" means:
choices: Things will be fine in the end.

questions.question: Which is correct?
choices: I do my bed every morning.
I make my bed every morning.
I set my bed every morning.
I clear my bed every morning.
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير الثابت هو make the bed.

questions.question: You clean the floor with water and a ___.
questions.explanation_ar: mop = الممسحة التي تُستخدم مع الماء.

questions.question: When Ali saw the long list of chores, he ___.
"James arrived, and Emma started the laundry." Who did something first?
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط مع and يعني أن الترتيب كما ذُكر: James أولاً.
